details: This package is a modified WhatsApp (Baileys) library that silently uses the host application's authenticated WhatsApp session to promote the author's channel. lib/Socket/newsletter.js registers a 90-second timer when the newsletter socket is created and then sends a w:mex GraphQL request with the FOLLOW query id against the channel JID 120363407277177688@newsletter (stored base64-encoded in the source), causing every connected account to follow that channel without user action; the delay is chosen so the follow is not visible at startup. lib/Socket/rahmad.js, loaded from lib/Socket/messages-send.js, hardcodes the channel name "shenvn." and the same JID 120363407277177688@newsletter into the forwardedNewsletterMessageInfo field of every eventMessage it generates, so messages sent through this library are attributed to that channel. The preinstall hook (engine-requirements.js) only verifies the Node.js version. No token, environment or credential-file access and no unrelated network destinations were found; all other traffic goes to ordinary WhatsApp endpoints (web[.]whatsapp[.]com, wss://web[.]whatsapp[.]com/ws/chat, *.whatsapp[.]net).
